General Help

 

MC311 Customer Service Center is Montgomery County’s source for nonemergency government information and services. You can reach MC311 for issues related to the Department of Permitting Services, Monday - Friday from 7 a.m. - 7 p.m.

In Montgomery County: Call 311
Outside of Montgomery County: 240-777-0311

Visiting DPS?

Visit us electronically: eServices 

2425 Reedie Drive, 7th floor
Wheaton, Maryland 20902

Monday - Friday; 7:30 a.m. - 4 p.m.

Map, Parking & Directions
